title: Largest Substring Between Two Equal Characters
description: Given a lowercase string `s`, return the length of the longest contiguous substring strictly between two equal characters (excluding the two equal characters themselves). If no character appears at least twice in `s`, return `-1`.
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters.
hints: To maximize distance between two occurrences of a character, always pair it with its very first occurrence.
Record the first index of each letter in a 26-element array and update max(best, i - first[c] - 1) on later occurrences.

examples.explanation: Between the two 'a's in "aa" lies an empty substring of length 0.
Between the two 'a's in "abca" lies "bc" of length 2.
All characters in "cbzxy" are unique, so return -1.
